verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Ezra 5

Haggai 1:2–10 rebukes the people; Zechariah son of Iddo; Darius busy securing his throne (Adeney); Kidner: a Babylonian record of 502 B.C. names "Ta-at[-tan-ni] governor of Ebernari" (name probably, office certainly); timber courses in walls a common building feature (Kidner); Sheshbazzar named in the letter — perhaps the same as Zerubbabel, or the official governor (Yamauchi)
